Is Rajgir REALLY the SECRET Battleground of Mahabharata? Jarasandha Ka Akhada
Uncover the lost history of the MAHABHARATA era right here in Rajgir, Bihar!
In this latest episode of my Rajgir travel vlog series, I take you to the legendary Jarasandha Ka Akhada (also known as Jarasandha's Battlefield or Ranbhumi). This ancient site is where the epic 14-day duel between Bhima and the powerful Magadha King Jarasandha took place, a pivotal moment in the Mahabharata story as directed by Lord Krishna.
